**Finding: deviation (WARRANTY)** — submitted.

- **What the document has:** § 5.1(a) a reasonable care-and-skill services warranty (effectively "professional and workmanlike"), § 5.1(b) authority, and a compliance-with-laws covenant (p0063).
- **What fails the fallback:** no conformance warranty for delivered Materials/Base Components, no warranty period, and no remedy. § 5.2 makes 5.1 exclusive and § 5.4(c) supplies all Materials "AS IS", so the disclaimer swallows any conformance protection.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** new § 5.1(c) adding a 90-day conformance and no-malicious-code warranty with re-performance / repair / replacement / refund as the remedy, plus an "Except as expressly warranted in Section 5.1" carve-out at the head of § 5.4(c).
- Pitched at the fallback duration (90 days) as proportionate for a hosting/services deal rather than the 12-month software period.
